title.rendered: Hazem Abdel-Mohsen, UAE Country Head at Arqaam Capital, shared insights on capital flows into the UAE

content.rendered:
Featured in Forbes, our very own Hazem Abdel-Mohsen shares insights on the evolving bridge between private and public markets across the GCC.

As regional capital pools mature and fixed income markets deepen, the focus is shifting from transaction volume to long-term market architecture.
Institutional discipline, liquidity, and investor diversification are strengthening across the region.

A structural evolution is underway.

View More
